prerequisites: Cálculo, diseño y ensayo de máquinas (596)

learning_outcomes.text: The student will know and apply advanced techniques for machine calculation and design.

syllabus_topics: CHAPTER I - Theories of Mechanical Failure
Lesson 1.- Design for Static Strength. Criteria.
Lesson 2.- Introduction to fracture mechanics.
Lesson 3.- Design for Fatigue Strength. Criteria
CHAPTER II - Design-Calculation of: SHAFTS and TRANSMISSION AXLES.
Lesson 4.- Shafts-Axles. Subjected to stationary-static loads.
Lesson 5.- Shafts-Axles. Subjected to variable loads.
Lesson 6.- Shafts-Axles. - Critical speeds in shafts. Interference fits.
CHAPTER III - Joints.
Lesson 7.- Preloaded bolted joints. High-strength bolts.
Lesson 8.- Bonded joints.
CHAPTER IV- Bearings.
Lesson 9.- Rolling contact bearings.
Lesson 10. Sliding contact bearings. Hydrodynamic bearings.
CHAPTER V. - Design-Calculation and Verification (AGMA) of Gears.
Lesson 11.- Gear kinematics. Conjugate teeth. Fundamental law of gearing.
Lesson 12.- Tooth modifications. Undercut teeth. Reference profile displacement.
Lesson 13.- Spur gears. Dimensioning according to AGMA standard. DIN standard.
CHAPTER VI. - Cables.
Lesson 14.- Funicular mechanics.
Lesson 15.- Types of cables. Cable transport.
assessment_rules: The completion of PRACTICALS (problems, laboratory, or computer-based) is mandatory to pass the evaluation criterion. 50% of the final tests must be passed. If this critical evaluation criterion is not met, the total course grade will be FAIL, with the resulting score from all evaluation systems truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points. Once the final tests are approved, the scores obtained will be weighted according to the established proportions.
